name: USS New Mexico
shortDescription: Twelve-gun mid-tier battleship, heavily armored, that needs patience to land its broadside.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 20s action, 80s cooldown, unlimited charges, the same cycle as New York's.

consumables.name: Repair Party
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 28s each at 266 hp/s, about 7,450 hp per activation, roughly 42% of her 53,200 hp pool across all three.

consumables.name: Observation Seaplane
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 30s duration, 200s cooldown. Tightens shell grouping 10% instead of extending vision or range, worth saving for a called shot rather than popping on cooldown.

strengths: Twelve 356mm guns across four turrets, good firing angles fore and aft, one of the biggest broadsides at tier V
Heavy belt and citadel protection plus 40% torpedo damage reduction, hard to core when angled
Respectable AA and decent concealment for a battleship, with a tighter turning radius than her top speed suggests
weaknesses: Slow main battery reload and mediocre dispersion blunt how hard the twelve-gun broadside hits in practice
Turret traverse is slow, a full swing takes a full minute, easy to get outangled by anything that closes fast
Slow speed and even slower acceleration make repositioning or disengaging painful
Large superstructure gives enemy gunners plenty to shoot at
tips: Angle in before you commit. Dispersion isn't great at range, so closing the distance a bit actually helps you land the broadside instead of just eating one.
Pop Observation Seaplane when you've got a clear shot lined up for the accuracy bump, not just because it's off cooldown.
Don't chase destroyers. The torpedo protection takes some sting out of a hit, but you still can't catch them, so let your cruisers handle it.

threats.threat: Destroyers and cruisers exploiting slow traverse
threats.reason: They can circle you faster than your turrets can track.
Your size and speed make you easy to line up, though the 40% damage reduction softens whatever lands.

summary: Twelve 356mm guns in four turrets, one of the biggest broadsides at tier V.
Slow and bulky, heavy armor and torpedo protection over mobility or accuracy.
Observation Seaplane tightens the group for one big volley, then it's on cooldown for a while.
playstyle.detail: New Mexico trades speed for a broadside that means business. Twelve guns landing together is a bad day for whoever's on the other end, and the heavy armor plus torpedo protection let her shrug off plenty on the way in. The dispersion isn't great and the reload is on the slow side, so she rewards patience: hold an angle, wait for a clean shot, and let Observation Seaplane tighten the group when you finally pull the trigger. Turret traverse is sluggish too, so she isn't built to chase anything that closes fast.

goalTags.note: Heavy belt and citadel protection plus 40% torpedo damage reduction make her hard to core even up close.
Three AA mounts with roughly 90 combined DPS on the upgraded hull, respectable for tier V.
